pipeline_name: Ehrenberg-Los Algodones-San Luis Rio Colorado Gas Pipeline

validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE/CLASSIFICATION confirmed independent of GEM. This is a real CFE-tendered, US-Mexico border gas import pipeline: CFE Director Enrique Ochoa publicly announced it 23 Apr 2014 as the fifth of five new gasoductos (Ehrenberg, Arizona -> San Luis Rio Colorado, Sonora; $250M investment; 130 MMcf/d), reported near-identically by Monitor Economico and Somos Industria (same press event = one origin). It then appears, under its full name 'Ehrenberg - Los Algodones - San Luis Rio Colorado', in SENER/CENACE's PRODESEN 2015-2029 planning document (Tabla 3.1.6 'Gasoductos en Proyecto': CFE-tendered, 160 km, $249M) and again in the PRODESEN 2016-2030 edition (30-May-2016; Tabla 4.1.7: target COD 2017, 160 km, $249M, benefiting Baja California and Sonora), and CENAGAS's Jan-2015 Plan Quinquenal explicitly names it (with Merida-Cancun) as being of a 'caracter comercial' (commercial, not strategic) nature, which is why CENAGAS asked CRE to exclude it from that Plan's evaluation. IEnova/Sempra's own Jul-2014 investor deck lists it as one of 17 market-wide National Infrastructure Program gas-pipeline tender opportunities (160 km, $246M capex, 2014 tender, 1Q2017 COD) -- a private-sector, non-GEM corroboration of existence/specs, distinct from the government sources. CLASSIFICATION as a gas transmission / import-capacity-reinforcement pipeline (not gathering/distribution) is correct: Plan Quinquenal groups it under 'Ductos que refuerzan la capacidad de internacion de gas natural de importacion al norte del pais'. Scope note: all figures found are for the pipeline as a whole (US Ehrenberg, AZ segment -> Mexican San Luis Rio Colorado, Sonora terminus); no source splits a separate US-only vs Mexico-only length/cost/capacity -- GEM's single-segment record for the whole line is the correct scope, not a mismatch.

validity.recommendation: Verify whether IEnova/Sempra Energy ever won or built this pipeline; no tender-award or construction document was found naming them as developer of THIS specific line.
validity.researcher_notes: Operator=IEnova / Owner1=Sempra Energy could NOT be independently confirmed. The only document found that mentions IEnova/Sempra in connection with this pipeline is Sempra/IEnova's own Jul-2014 investor presentation, and there it appears ONLY inside a market-wide table titled 'Announced Natural Gas Pipeline Projects' listing all 17 Mexican National Infrastructure Program gas-pipeline tenders (Ojinaga-El Encino, Waha-Samalayuca, Tula-Villa de Reyes, etc.) as a sector opportunity overview -- not as an IEnova-specific asset or award. SENER's PRODESEN tables (2015-2029 and 2016-2030 editions) both list this project's tender authority as 'Licitado por: CFE' and give no winning-bidder/awardee name; PRODESEN still carried it in the LEAST-advanced 'Gasoductos en Proyecto' (not-yet-under-construction) category as of mid-2016. IEnova's CURRENT (2025) asset map, fetched and visually reviewed from ienova.com.mx, shows IEnova's actual Baja California/Sonora gas pipeline network and does NOT include an Ehrenberg-Los Algodones-San Luis Rio Colorado line. Searched: FERC eLibrary general search (elibrary.ferc.gov/eLibrary/search) -- returns 200 but is a JS-rendered SPA, not scriptable via curl, and no docket number for this project was otherwise discoverable; DOE/FECM presidential-permit and NG-export-authorization listing pages -- guessed URLs 404'd and no working search engine was available in this environment to locate the correct listing page (WebSearch budget exhausted; DuckDuckGo/Bing via curl returned bot-walls / irrelevant cached content, reproducibly). Given the absence of any award, FERC Section 3 filing, or Presidential Permit evidence, and the project's total disappearance from PRODESEN's 2018-2032 edition (see status_reviews), Operator/Owner attribution to IEnova/Sempra is plausible (they are the dominant private gas operator in that exact border corridor) but UNCONFIRMED as this specific project's developer -- flagging rather than silently passing per the attribution priority rule.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: No independent news found of an explicit cancellation/withdrawal. Over 9 years dormant since the last positive mention, well past the 4y shelved->cancelled threshold -- the recorded 'cancelled' status is consistent with this evidence, so verdict stays 'confirm-by-inference' (staged as 'stale' per the dormancy-rule instructions). ShelvedCancelledType='inferred' proposed with no fabricated ref per standing rule 2. No CancelledYear is proposed -- no dated withdrawal was found, only the absence pattern above; forcing a specific year (e.g. 2017, the missed target, or 2018, the last-checked absence) would be a fabricated precision this evidence does not support.
